Latin word

summum

adverb (neuter of summus), after the number or time it limits

at most, at the utmost; at the latest

In this lexicon

  • maximum

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Fam. 2.1.1: bis terve summum; Cic. Att. 13.21.2: hodiē aut summum crās; Traupman 102: hodiē, summum crās, today, at latest tomorrow; Traupman 162; Traupman 212, 213: vīgintī aut summum trīgintā minūtīs, in twenty or at most thirty minutes

  • summum cōnsilium: cabinet

    modern

  • summum tabulātum: top floor

    * our formation

Examples

  • ā tē vērō bis terve summum et eās perbrevīs accēpī

    but from you I have had two or three letters at most, and very short onesCic. Fam. 2.1.1

    In the entry for maximum

  • exspectābam hodiē aut summum crās ab eō tabellāriōs

    I was expecting couriers from him today, or tomorrow at the latestCic. Att. 13.21.2
